delivery_mix_target.rule: Do not generate people, factory shots, installations or finished furniture while suitable real licensed footage is available.

forbidden: named partners, suppliers or compliance claims
claims_policy.cta: Salamat Mebel — мебель, созданная под ваше пространство.

blocks.name: Hook
blocks.purpose: immediate premium visual impact; Salamat Mebel name/logo; one concise positioning phrase

blocks.name: What we do
blocks.purpose: custom furniture; from idea and measurements to finished installation; interiors tailored to the actual room and customer task

blocks.name: Production and craftsmanship
blocks.purpose: material selection, cutting/CNC, edge processing, finishing, hardware/details, assembly — real footage wherever possible

blocks.name: Product range
blocks.purpose: kitchens; wardrobes/storage; children's / bathroom / TV units; commercial furniture — strong representative shots, no catalogue overload

blocks.name: Quality + installation
blocks.purpose: detail quality, installation, fit/finish, result in the interior

blocks.name: Brand close / CTA
blocks.purpose: logo; concise call to action; no invented contact data

scenes.narration: Salamat Mebel. Мебель, которую создают под ваше пространство.
scenes.editorial_purpose: Open on a premium interior detail so the first impression is the product, not the brand.
scenes.visual_intent: Slow deliberate push-in on a modern kitchen in warm evening light; a single brass/dark handle detail in focus; wordmark fades in over the last two seconds.
footage_queries: modern kitchen interior slow dolly evening warm light
premium kitchen detail cabinet handle macro
fallback_queries: luxury kitchen dark wood countertop closeup
scenes.fallback_asset_intent: one cinematic still of a premium modern kitchen with a single hardware detail, no people, no readable text
scenes.approval_notes: Wordmark must be simple text; no invented slogan and no contact data at the hook.

scenes.narration: Корпусная мебель на заказ в Алматы и Алматинской области.
scenes.editorial_purpose: State what the company does and where, in one readable sentence.
scenes.visual_intent: Wide interior shot opening up behind the title; the room tells the geography is not the point — the result is.
footage_queries: modern apartment interior wide shot open plan kitchen
scandinavian living room kitchen wide interior
fallback_queries: bright modern apartment interior wide angle
kitchen dining area wide interior daylight
scenes.fallback_asset_intent: wide bright apartment interior with built-in cabinetry, no people, no readable text
scenes.approval_notes: Geography limited to Almaty / Almaty region as supplied; no address, no phone.

scenes.narration: Один подрядчик на весь путь: замер, проект, производство и установка.
scenes.editorial_purpose: Explain the end-to-end workflow before showing the factory.
scenes.visual_intent: Designer at a wall with a laser measure, then hands over drawings on a table; cut on the drawing, not the face.
footage_queries: carpenter measuring wall laser meter interior
interior designer drawing blueprint hands table
fallback_queries: measuring tape wall cabinet installation planning
scenes.fallback_asset_intent: process still: measurement and planning at a wall with drawings, hands only, anonymous
scenes.approval_notes: Process statement only; no timing or delivery promise.

scenes.narration: Начинаем с задачи и планировки: где будет удобно готовить, хранить и отдыхать.
scenes.editorial_purpose: Show that the project starts from the room and the customer's habits, not from a catalogue.
scenes.visual_intent: Consultation at the kitchen table: plans, samples, a phone with a floor plan; over-the-shoulder framing.
footage_queries: client consultation interior design samples table
couple reviewing kitchen plan blueprints table
fallback_queries: hands pointing at kitchen floor plan on table
material samples swatches on table consultation
scenes.fallback_asset_intent: consultation still: floor plan and material samples on a table, hands only, no faces
scenes.approval_notes: No claim of free design service, no timing.

scenes.narration: Материалы и фурнитуру выбираем вместе — под задачу и стиль интерьера.
scenes.editorial_purpose: Hand control of the look and feel to the customer before the factory block.
scenes.visual_intent: Fan of decor samples and hardware pieces on a worktop; hands moving slowly across the samples.
footage_queries: material samples laminate wood swatches table hands
cabinet hardware samples hinges handles display
fallback_queries: color swatches interior design flat lay
scenes.fallback_asset_intent: flat-lay still of surface samples and cabinet hardware in warm light
scenes.approval_notes: No brand names of suppliers, no certification claims.

scenes.narration: Основа проекта — качественные материалы и надёжная фурнитура.
scenes.editorial_purpose: Enter the production block by naming the raw material standard.
scenes.visual_intent: Stack of laminated panels and a sheet being lifted onto a cutting table; slow lateral move.
footage_queries: furniture factory panel sheets stacking workshop
melamine board stack production line slow pan
scenes.fallback_asset_intent: workshop still of panel sheets stacked and lifted, industrial warm light
scenes.approval_notes: Generic material statement only; no supplier or grade specification.

scenes.narration: Раскрой и ЧПУ: детали делают на станках, по проекту.
scenes.editorial_purpose: Prove machine-based precision without inventing numbers.
scenes.visual_intent: CNC router cutting a panel with dust extraction; close on the cutter path and the panel groove.
footage_queries: cnc router cutting wood panel furniture factory closeup
nesting cnc machine drilling cabinet parts
fallback_queries: cnc machine wood dust extraction production
scenes.fallback_asset_intent: machining still: CNC head cutting a panel, dust and warm light, no branding
scenes.approval_notes: Do not state tolerance numbers (e.g. 'до миллиметра') — not verified.

scenes.narration: Кромку обрабатывают на производстве — торцы ровные, стыки аккуратные.
scenes.editorial_purpose: Show the finishing step that a customer can actually see at home.
scenes.visual_intent: Edge banding machine feeding a panel; macro of the finished edge and the joinery line.
footage_queries: edge banding machine furniture factory panel closeup
edgebander gluing pvc edge panel macro
fallback_queries: furniture panel edge finish closeup workshop
scenes.fallback_asset_intent: macro still of a finished panel edge and tight joinery, workshop light
scenes.approval_notes: Quality described visually; no durability guarantee.

scenes.narration: Фурнитура, доводчики, направляющие: двери и ящики работают мягко.
scenes.editorial_purpose: Move from structure to the parts the customer touches every day.
scenes.visual_intent: Macro of hinges, soft-close damper and drawer runners; a drawer closing slowly into place.
footage_queries: cabinet hinge soft close mechanism macro slow motion
drawer runner slides close up furniture hardware
scenes.fallback_asset_intent: hardware macro still: hinges and runners on a panel with cinematic side light
scenes.approval_notes: No hardware brand names; 'работают мягко' describes the visible mechanism, not a warranty.

scenes.narration: Корпуса собирают и проверяют в цеху, до выезда на объект.
scenes.editorial_purpose: Close block C: assembly and check happen before the customer's home.
scenes.visual_intent: Two workers clamping and aligning a cabinet carcase; measured camera move along the assembly bench.
footage_queries: cabinet assembly workshop workers clamps furniture
furniture factory assembly line cabinet carcase
fallback_queries: workshop bench furniture parts assembly hands
scenes.fallback_asset_intent: assembly still: cabinet carcase clamped on a bench, gloved hands, no faces
scenes.approval_notes: No claim about quality-control certificates or staff numbers.

scenes.narration: Кухни: от компактных до просторных, с островом и барной зоной.
scenes.editorial_purpose: Open the range block with the strongest single category.
scenes.visual_intent: Slow arc across a finished kitchen: fronts, worktop, island; then a detail of the joinery line.
footage_queries: modern kitchen island interior slow pan premium
designer kitchen with bar counter interior
scenes.fallback_asset_intent: premium finished kitchen still with island, no people, no readable text
scenes.approval_notes: Category naming only; no configuration or price claims.

scenes.narration: Шкафы, встроенное хранение и прихожие — под размеры помещения.
scenes.editorial_purpose: Show built-in storage as a fit-to-room capability.
scenes.visual_intent: Sliding wardrobe doors opening to a lit interior; then hallway storage with vertical lines.
footage_queries: built in wardrobe sliding doors interior opening
hallway storage cabinets modern interior
fallback_queries: walk in closet built in shelves interior
entryway built in closet interior design
scenes.fallback_asset_intent: built-in storage still: full-height wardrobe with interior lighting, no people
scenes.approval_notes: No modular/fitted terminology that implies a different product line.

scenes.narration: Детская, ванная, ТВ-зоны и мебель для небольших комнат.
scenes.editorial_purpose: Cover the secondary room categories in one calm beat.
scenes.visual_intent: Three short matched shots: children's room cabinetry, bathroom vanity unit, living-room TV wall.
footage_queries: children room built in wardrobe furniture interior
bathroom vanity cabinet modern interior
living room tv wall unit built in furniture
fallback_queries: tv unit media wall living room interior
scenes.fallback_asset_intent: three matched stills (children's room, bathroom vanity, TV wall) in one consistent visual language
scenes.approval_notes: No safety-certification claims for children's furniture.

scenes.narration: Отдельное направление — ресепшн, офисы, медицинские и коммерческие помещения.
scenes.editorial_purpose: Signal B2B capability to the secondary audience without claiming compliance.
scenes.visual_intent: Reception desk with integrated storage; then a calm office/medical front with clean lines.
footage_queries: reception desk office interior modern wood
office furniture clinic reception counter interior
fallback_queries: office built in cabinets interior design
scenes.fallback_asset_intent: commercial furniture still: reception counter with integrated millwork, no people, no readable branding
scenes.approval_notes: No medical compliance, hygiene or certification claims; 'отдельное направление' only.

scenes.narration: Доставка и монтаж на объекте — завершающий этап проекта.
scenes.editorial_purpose: Close the workflow loop that block B opened.
scenes.visual_intent: Installer leveling a cabinet run, protecting the floor; tool and level detail; then the finished line.

kitchen installation worker fitting cabinet doors
scenes.fallback_asset_intent: installation still: hands with a level on a cabinet run, floor protection visible
scenes.approval_notes: No delivery-time promise, no 'clean-up included' claim (not verified).

scenes.narration: Результат: мебель, которая встроена в ваше пространство.
scenes.editorial_purpose: Give the viewer the finished after-state before the brand close.
scenes.visual_intent: Wide, quiet shot of the finished interior; slow drift, no cuts — let the room hold.

scenes.approval_notes: No customer name or project reference — nothing that implies a real named client.

scenes.narration: Salamat Mebel — мебель, созданная под ваше пространство.
scenes.editorial_purpose: Hold the brand long enough to be remembered and read the CTA on a phone.
